title: Pure Stealth Kragen
summary: The Rank 4 WATER Shark and Stealth Kragen control build, centered on Number 4: Stealth Kragen and its Extra Deck offspring Stealth Kragen Spawn. Because Stealth Kragen turns every face-up monster on the field into a WATER monster, its Quick Effect destruction hits any opposing monster and Gozen Match locks the opponent out of non-WATER summons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Buzzsaw Shark targets a WATER monster you control (including itself) to Special Summon a Level 4 Fish with a different name (Lantern Shark or Crystal Shark) from your Deck, assembling a 1-card Rank 4 WATER Xyz.
Beautunaful Princess (and One for One to summon it) banishes itself on summon to Special Summon Buzzsaw Shark directly from your Deck.
Abyss Shark Special Summons itself from your hand while you control only WATER monsters, searches a Level 3 to 5 Fish, and counts as Level 4 for the Xyz Summon of a Number monster.
Lantern Shark Special Summons a Level 3 to 5 WATER Fish from your hand on Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Beautunaful Princess or Buzzsaw Shark
steps: Normal Summon Beautunaful Princess and banish it to Special Summon Buzzsaw Shark from the Deck.
Target Buzzsaw Shark with its own effect to Special Summon Lantern Shark or Crystal Shark from the Deck, and extend with Abyss Shark or Silent Angler if in hand.
Overlay two Level 4 WATER Fish into Number 4: Stealth Kragen, and activate Fury of Kairyu-Shin to search Torrential Tribute and Set it alongside Gozen Match.

summary.title: Kragen & Spawn Floating Loop
summary.text: Both Number 4: Stealth Kragen and Stealth Kragen Spawn have a Main Phase Quick Effect to destroy 1 WATER monster your opponent controls without targeting, with Number 4 also burning for half that monster's ATK. When Number 4 is destroyed, it Special Summons Stealth Kragen Spawn from your Extra Deck up to the number of Xyz Materials it had and attaches a WATER monster from your GY to each. When those Stealth Kragen Spawn are destroyed, they revive Number 4: Stealth Kragen from your GY and attach WATER monsters from your GY, creating a continuous floating loop.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Gozen Match combined with Number 4: Stealth Kragen's continuous WATER Attribute conversion prevents your opponent from summoning any non-WATER monster while they control a face-up monster.

Fury of Kairyu-Shin searches Torrential Tribute and banishes itself from the GY to protect your WATER monsters from effect destruction, or you can let Torrential Tribute destroy a 2-material Number 4 to split it into two Stealth Kragen Spawn.
Crystal Shark can target an opponent's monster turned WATER by Stealth Kragen to halve its ATK and revive itself from the GY.
Toadally Awesome, Valiant Shark Lancer, Number 37: Hope Woven Dragon Spider Shark, and Marincess Coral Anemone round out the WATER Extra Deck.

main: Buzzsaw Shark
Core 1-card Rank 4 starter: targets a Level 4 WATER monster (including itself!) to Special Summon a Level 4 Fish from your Deck—immediately Xyz Summoning Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
Beautunaful Princess
Copies 4–6 of Buzzsaw Shark: banishes itself on Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon Buzzsaw Shark directly from your Deck!
Abyss Shark

Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a WATER monster, adds Crystal Shark, Buzzsaw Shark, or Silent Angler from your Deck to your hand, and counts as Level 4 for the Xyz Summon of Number 4: Stealth Kragen!
Lantern Shark
Special Summons a Level 4 WATER Fish from your hand on Normal or Special Summon to assemble a second Rank 4 WATER Xyz alongside Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
Crystal Shark

Special Summons itself from your hand OR GY by targeting any WATER monster on the field (including an opponent's monster turned WATER by Number 4: Stealth Kragen!) and counts as Level 4 for a Number Xyz Summon.
Silent Angler
Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a WATER monster for easy Rank 4 extension.
Fury of Kairyu-Shin
Adds 'Torrential Tribute' from your Deck to your hand, and banishes itself from your GY if your WATER monster(s) would be destroyed by card effect instead.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Beautunaful Princess from your Deck (which summons Buzzsaw Shark -> Lantern Shark -> Number 4: Stealth Kragen without using your Normal Summon!).
Torrential Tribute

Searched by Fury of Kairyu-Shin: destroys all monsters on the field on summon, either leaving Number 4 protected via Fury of Kairyu-Shin OR destroying your 2-material Number 4: Stealth Kragen to immediately summon TWO Stealth Kragen Spawn from your Extra Deck!
Gozen Match

Limited to 1 in TCG: combined with Number 4: Stealth Kragen (which turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER Attribute), prevents your opponent from Normal, Flip, or Special Summoning any non-WATER monster while they control a face-up monster!
